title: Grateful Dead Live at Kiel Auditorium on 1973-10-29
source: MSR > C > D > CD patched with AUD

ai_review.summary: Audience‑only recording of a solid ’73 show featuring a standout Dark Star, though the drum mix is noticeably thin.
ai_review.review: The concert captures a classic 1973 vibe that fans enjoy – not too fast and not too slow – with Dark Star highlighted as a high point. The audio is an audience capture lacking stage mics, resulting in a generally fair sound but a poor Bill Kreutzmann mix, especially on Wharf Rat. Overall it’s a decent listening experience for Deadheads who love the ’73 era.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (Dark Star, classic ’73 feel) while recording quality is limited to audience‑only source with a weak drum mix; weighted average yields a solid but not stellar rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: All‑audience capture, no stage mics used; overall acceptable but some “funny audio stuff” and notably poor drum mix (Bill) on Wharf Rat.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Balanced pacing – described as ‘not too fast and not too slow’ – delivering a typical energetic ’73 set that flows well despite limited recording fidelity.

band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's (Bill Kreutzmann) mix is called out as poor, especially during Wharf Rat.
